description: This file contains a helper class for testing call chain reentrancy in Orleans grains, including multiple test scenarios and an observer for call chain events.

classes.name: CallChainReentrancyTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class to run various test cases related to call chain reentrancy in Orleans grains.

classes.name: CallChainObserver
classes.description: An observer class that monitors call chain operations and synchronization during tests.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_1
methods.description: Tests allowed reentrancy for identical grains.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_2
methods.description: Tests reentrancy across different grains with similar identifiers.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_3
methods.description: Tests reentrancy with alternating reentrant and non-reentrant grains.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_4
methods.description: Tests a direct call chain between two reentrant grains without deadlock.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_5
methods.description: Tests a chain with mixed reentrant and non-reentrant grains avoiding deadlock.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_6
methods.description: Tests reentrancy on non-reentrant grains in a chain.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_WithSuppression
methods.description: Tests suppression of call chain reentrancy, ensuring subsequent calls are blocked appropriately.
